assumptions.note: Raw MCHQ contains the CPI samples; 64 km/800 Hz are requested replay-processing limits, not RF recording limits.

cutout_inventory.note: These are requested cutout extents. Replay JSON cutouts were deleted by the runner after scoring, so retained result files do not preserve actual complex cutout cells.

requirements: event-time timestamp for every source observation
at least two independent sources at every held CPI
position and velocity projected from each source event time to the CPI midpoint
projection method, source identifiers, source event times, raw ages, and covariance retained
maximum pairwise projected horizontal disagreement <= 0.5 km
maximum pairwise projected velocity disagreement <= 10 m/s
uncertainty tube fits both the predeclared search and retained cutout on every CPI
fresh_only_acceptance.validation_rule: Select/rank every tube cell; apply the tube-size trial factor only in validation against identically maximized translated controls.
